prompts.impartial: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: landscape cover art for a Chinese essay card and article page, approximately 8:5 aspect ratio. Primary request: a thoughtful panda representing impartiality, standing beside a level brass balance scale on a stone table in a misty traditional Chinese mountain courtyard. Style/medium: richly detailed painterly Chinese ink-and-watercolor fantasy illustration, textured paper, atmospheric layered mountains, expressive soft panda, cool blue-gray ink with restrained warm golden light, in the same visual family as the project's Chinese panda essay illustrations. Composition/framing: panda and balanced scales near center, keep the main subjects clear within the central 60 percent for card cropping, beautiful wide landscape around them. Mood: calm, fair, reflective. Constraints: one panda, coherent scale with exactly two balanced pans, no lettering, no calligraphy, no text, no logos or watermarks.
